# Dastak 90807 (Dastak Online Document Facilitation)

> Independent document facilitation service run by Muhammad Usman, a registered facilitator under the Government of Punjab's Maryam Ki Dastak program (Facilitator Code 90807). This is not a government website or department. Fees are generated by the official Dastak system. Always verify details on the official portal (https://dastak.punjab.gov.pk) or helpline 1202.

## Key pages
- [Services](https://www.dastak90807.com/en/services/): driving license, police, vehicle, civil document and guidance services in Punjab
- [How it works](https://www.dastak90807.com/en/how-it-works/): booking in the official Dastak app (Doorstep Delivery, then Self or On Behalf, with Facilitator Code 90807), WhatsApp or phone
- [About and how to verify me](https://www.dastak90807.com/en/about/)
- [FAQs](https://www.dastak90807.com/en/faqs/)
- [Contact](https://www.dastak90807.com/en/contact/): WhatsApp and phone 0345-5583530
- [Disclaimer](https://www.dastak90807.com/en/disclaimer/)

## Area
Doorstep facilitation in Gujar Khan, Rawalpindi, Kallar Syedan, Kahuta, Mandra, Bewal, Daultala, Jatli, Sukho, and Qazian; online document facilitation across all districts of Punjab, Pakistan. Inquiries accepted 24 hours. Doorstep visits by arrangement.

## Urdu version (اردو)
Urdu pages mirror the English URLs under /ur/ (same slugs). Fees on Urdu pages follow the official Dastak training manual (V-5, 26 June 2025) and the official Dastak portal; the PSID shows the final amount. Facilitator charge: Rs 950 per service. Domicile via Dastak: Rs 1,200 total by PSID (Rs 300 e-stamp affidavit separate).
